responsibility: Implements the C11/C23 <stdatomic.h> API on top of GCC’s __atomic builtins by defining the memory_order enumeration, the standard atomic typedef family, lock-free property macros, atomic_flag, fences, initialization helpers, and the generic atomic load/store/exchange/compare/fetch macros using __auto_type and built-in operations. Its responsibility is to present the language-standard atomic programming interface while delegating actual synchronization semantics and target lowering to GCC’s atomic builtins and backend support.
